text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from roughly 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling, less typing in the parking lot.

**2. CRM data got better.** Notes were consistent, so pipeline reviews stopped relying on memory.

**3. Customers noticed.** Asking consent upfront built trust. Two prospects even asked for the summary.

**4. Adoption wasn't automatic.** Reps who saw managers use the summaries in coaching stuck with it. The rest drifted.

**5. Spotty connectivity hurt.** Rural visits needed an offline fallback.

Our takeaway: the tool saves time, but leadership habits decide whether it sticks.

What did your team learn from your first AI pilot?
